title: Meet the Point Hacks MCP App
body:
Ask ChatGPT or Claude which card gets you to Europe in Business Class fastest, and get an answer built on Point Hacks’ live offers, not guesswork.
We have developed a way for you to search for our credit card and frequent flyer offers through ChatGPT and Claude. It’s called the Point Hacks MCP App.
Without the app, a chatbot might quote an expired bonus or a made-up earn rate. With it, you get current Australian offers plus our expert view.
Finding the right credit card or frequent flyer offer can mean comparing annual fees, points earn rates, sign-up bonuses and perks across multiple websites. If you already use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to help with your research, the app makes it easier to find and compare our offers in one place.
What is the Point Hacks MCP App?
The app connects our credit card and frequent flyer offers with compatible AI chatbots, helping you find relevant information and compare your options.
Once connected, you can ask for recommendations. Ask questions like:
Help me browse the current card offers from Point Hacks.
I spend about $4k a month and want to fly Business Class to Japan next year. Which card gets me there the quickest?
I’ve got an Amex Explorer. What should I get next for a big Velocity bonus?
Compare the top three Qantas cards for me on fees, bonus and lounge access.
It’s like having Point Hacks in your back pocket, with our offers and expertise available directly through your AI chatbot.
How it works
Getting started is simple. Click the button for your preferred compatible AI chatbot and follow the steps to connect Point Hacks.
Choose Claude or ChatGPT below
Click Connect (Claude) or Try in Chat (ChatGPT)
Start asking questions
Once connected, you can ask any question and see your options side by side. You can then click through to open the guides and apply.
Claude
Add Point Hacks in Claude
Opens the Point Hacks listing in the Claude Directory — click connect, no setup.
ChatGPT
Add Point Hacks in ChatGPT
Opens the app page — click “Try in chat” to connect.
It works best on a personal account. Work accounts may require your IT team’s approval.
Examples
Getting started is easy. Watch the video below for a quick walkthrough of how to connect the Point Hacks extension and use it to find and compare credit card offers, all within your AI chatbot.
A few things to know
The app gives you access to current credit card and frequent flyer offers, so you can explore available bonuses without worrying about expired deals.
Designed to help you discover and compare offers, the app can recommend relevant offers and link you to Point Hacks’ guide for more details before directing you to the provider’s sign-up page.
For the most relevant recommendations, be specific about what you’re looking for. Whether it’s a Qantas credit card with a big sign-up bonus or a card that earns more Velocity points, the more detail you provide, the better the app can tailor its suggestions.
The app is built for finding credit card and frequent flyer offers. For flight searches, reward seats and bookings, you’ll still need to use the relevant airline or booking platform.
Next time you’re looking for a new credit card or frequent flyer offer, connect the Point Hacks MCP App and put your AI chatbot to work finding options that suit your travel goals.
Want to know more?
Visit our App Documentation guide for more detailed information on the Point Hacks MCP App.
Having trouble connecting?
Client How to connect
ChatGPT
Apps / Connectors settings → Create app → URL https://mcp-app.pointhacks.com/mcp
Claude
Connector settings → Add custom connector → URL https://mcp-app.pointhacks.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
If your organization restricts community connectors or apps, ask your admin to allowlist this server.
